This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Chronicle Books]]' [https://www.chroniclebooks.com/ official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Chronicle|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*'''url''': URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.chroniclebooks.com/</nowiki></code>).
*'''text''': Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Chronicle|url=star-wars-kirigami.html|text=Star Wars Kirigami|archivedate=20170911025722}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Chronicle|url=star-wars-kirigami.html|text=Star Wars Kirigami|archivedate=20170911025722}}
